subject: Língua Portuguesa
description_pt: Planejar e produzir, em colaboração com os colegas e com a ajuda do professor, notícias curtas para público infantil, para compor jornal falado que possa ser repassado oralmente ou em meio digital, em áudio ou vídeo, dentre outros gêneros do campo jornalístico, considerando a situação comunicativa e o tema/assunto do texto.

components.description_pt: Planejar uma breve reportagem para audiência infantil a ser incluída em telejornal infantil
components.description_en: Plan a short news story for a child audience to be included in a spoken-news broadcast

components.description_pt: Produzir uma breve reportagem para apresentação oral ou digital considerando situação comunicativa
components.description_en: Produce a short news story for oral or digital delivery considering the communicative situation
components.cc_component_description: Plan a writing piece by considering the purpose and intended audience before drafting

components.description_pt: Adaptar conteúdo jornalístico ao tema e audiência de um telejornal infantil
components.description_en: Adapt journalistic content to the topic and audience of a children's spoken-news broadcast
components.cc_component_description: Adapt presentation style and language to suit a specific purpose and audience

cc_matches.description: With some guidance and support from peers and adults, develop and strengthen writing as needed by planning, revising, editing, rewriting, or trying a new approach, focusing on how well purpose and audience have been addressed.

Present information, findings, and supporting evidence clearly, concisely, and logically such that listeners can follow the line of reasoning and the organization, development, substance, and style are appropriate to purpose, audience, and task.
